description: This file implements a custom, lock-free version of localtime() for Redis, handling timezone and daylight saving adjustments, and includes a leap year calculation. It is designed to be fork() friendly and suitable for Redis logging purposes.

methods.name: is_leap_year
methods.description: Determines if a given year (represented as time_t) is a leap year.

methods.name: nolocks_localtime
methods.description: Converts a time_t value to a broken-down time (struct tm) without locks, adjusting for timezone and daylight saving time.
